record.question: With reference to the structural and electoral provisions of the Panchayati Raj Institutions under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, consider the following statements: I. The Act explicitly mandates the creation of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system in every State, without any exceptions regarding the State's population size. II. All members of the Panchayats at the village, intermediate, and district levels must be elected directly by the people. III. The Chairperson of a Panchayat at the intermediate and district levels must be elected directly by the people from the respective territorial constituencies. How many of the statements given above are correct?
